{{- /* Full text of a page and everything below it, in navigation order. Builds and returns a string (instead of printing) so no HTML escaping is applied to the Markdown. */ -}} {{- $out := "" -}} {{- if and (not (partial "llms/is-reference.html" .)) (ne .Section "sitemap") -}} {{- if not .IsHome -}} {{- $body := partial "llms/body.html" . | strings.TrimSpace -}} {{- $out = printf "\n\n---\n\n# %s\n\nSource: %s\n\n%s\n" .Title .Permalink $body -}} {{- end -}} {{- range .Pages.ByWeight -}} {{- $out = printf "%s%s" $out (partial "llms/walk.html" .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
